Dialogs.Dialog: Today is my... Can I take it that you came because you remembered？
I'm so happy to see you... because today is...
Hehe！ You remembered what today is. My birthday♪
Happy birthday. Let's continue to get along.
I remember what today is. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday. Let's celebrate lots, just us two？
Today's the day we first met. Did you remember？
Today is the precious anniversary of the day you and I first met...
Do you remember the day we first met？ Today is that anniversary▼
Today's the anniversary of when we started dating... I'd like to celebrate.
Do you remember the day we started dating？ Today is our anniversary.
Today is the anniversary of when we became a couple, right？ I love you even more than back then▼
Okay, Monday. The start of another new week.
Today's Tuesday. Getting into the swing of things？
Wednesday. Not slacking off？ Let's stay sharp and do our best？
Thursday. Half the week's already gone.
It's Friday already. Have you thought about plans for the weekend？
Saturday. Everyone seems to be in a cheerful mood.
Hey, it's Sunday, you know？ I want to make the most of the day.
The spring weather is so warm... it feels nice.
On hot days, moving your body and working up a sweat might feel even better.
Autumn is the season to work hard at sports, studies, all sorts of things, right？
If you stay shut up in your room because it's cold, your body will get sluggish.
Ah, I'm in your care today too.
Um... I'm happy to see you.
I wanted to see you... so much.
I was waiting for you today too.
The time we can't see each other feels so long...
I'm happy you came to see me.
Are you happy to see me too？ Just kidding.
I want to see your face more often.
I want to see you... that's all I can think about.
You have to come sooner... Would saying that be selfish？
To make up for the wait, stay with me a long time, okay？
When I'm with you, all kinds of things feel fun.
I wonder how many times I've said in my heart that I wanted to see you.
I was thinking about what to talk about when you came.
I had a feeling you'd be coming about now.
Hurry, hurry！ There's so much I want to ask you.
Happy New Year. Let's make this year wonderful too... the two of us.
Did you have your first dream of the year？ I already did. What it was about... Hehe, I won't tell.
You know... I had my first dream of the year. Whether you were in it is... a secret.
Want to hear my first dream？ Maybe after I hear about yours？
Today's Valentine's Day, so you must be fidgety, right？
Today's a special day for girls... so look forward to it.
Happy Valentine's Day！ I want you to come see me soon.
What's today's date？ If you don't know, shall I tell you？ Just kidding.
March 14th. The person you owe a return gift to is... me, right？
Today's White Day！ Actually, I was looking forward to it.
I heard April Fool's Day got moved to tomorrow. ...That's a lie.
Sorry. I was thinking of a funny lie, and it was already April 1st.
You know, I'm confident I can see through your lies？ Just kidding.
I've always loved school excursions. I'm sure I can walk as much as it takes.
Ah, ah～！ The chorus contest... I'm nervous...
Today's Tanabata. Will we see the Milky Way？ I hope so.
The Towano Festival. I'd love to wear a yukata and go together.
Now, today's sports day, right？ I hope our hard work pays off.
Happy Halloween！ I have to get lots of candy ready.
Today's the school festival. I want to go around and see lots together.
Spending it with family is nice too, but Christmas... is with you, after all.
Christmas Eve. I wonder if it'll be a white Christmas...
Christmas Eve night makes me so restless. ...When I was little, I mean？
Thank you so much for everything this year. Thanks to you, it was a wonderful year▼
Good or bad, you have to accept your test results properly.
Um... my birthday's coming up. Will you celebrate with me？
Your birthday's coming up. Looking forward to it？ Hehe.
It's almost the day we started dating. Don't forget, okay？
It's already that time of year. There are so many chocolates, I can't decide.
White Day's coming soon, you know？ There, I put some pressure on you, hehe.
Fun lies, funny lies... but no sad lies, okay？
There's an excursion coming up, right？ If just the two of us went, would it still be an excursion？
The chorus contest is soon. Can you do proper abdominal breathing？
I hope it's clear on Tanabata. Maybe I'll start asking the teru teru bozu now？
The Towano Festival is almost here. Um... can I put it in our plans？
Sports day is coming, so maybe we should train together.
Halloween is approaching. I wonder what costumes we'll see this year.
The school festival is almost here. Let's work together to make it a good one.
Christmas is almost here. I'd be happy if we could spend Christmas Eve together...
Only a little of this year is left. I hope we greet a good new year together.
The exams are coming up, but if you study properly beforehand, there's nothing to worry about.
Tomorrow should be fun. I wonder what'll happen.
Tomorrow is... Ah, never mind！ Don't worry about it.
I wish tomorrow would come already♪
Today's our date, you know？ Double-check the time.
Geez, it's time for our date, right？ Hurry and come, okay？
Tomorrow's our date. Of course, you haven't forgotten, right？
Is there anything you want to eat？ If my cooking is okay...
This town keeps growing and changing. I want us to keep watching it change together.
Looks like a new shop opened. I'd love to go together.
What are the popular spots these days, I wonder？ Want to look it up later？
You haven't been texting me lately... is it just because you're busy？
You stopped texting me lately... so I...
You could at least text me. Otherwise, I...
We haven't seen each other at all lately... Why？
You haven't come to see me much lately... Are you going to keep that up？
Are you fine not seeing me...？ I'm lonely.
We're a couple... so I think kissing is important too...
Um... I've been feeling like you don't kiss me lately...
Hey... we haven't been kissing much, have we.
Are you okay？ You look a little sick... Don't overdo it, okay？
Studying seems to be going well. Keep it up.
Hehe. You look like you're overflowing with knowledge. You're in top form, huh？
You seem to be in great physical shape. I think that's great.
Are you in good shape right now？ Top form！ Maybe？
You're really sharp lately, huh？ It feels like your sense is getting polished.
You've been so sharp lately... Yes, I can feel your sense.
Lately you seem to sparkle... That's how attractive I think you are.
It's late, but I wanted to see you before Valentine's was over.
I'm glad I got to see you... I'm happy.
